description.text: Main courses: Chinese language, Computer science, Medical physics, China profile, Basic chemistry, Higher mathematics, Chinese medicine language, Cell biology, Histology and embryology, Regional anatomy, Biochemistry and molecular biology, Systematic anatomy, Physiology, Pathology, Immunology, Pharmacology, Microbiology, Medical genetics, Parasitology, Pathophysiology, Medical ethics, Basic surgery, Diagnostics, Nuclear medicine, Forensic medicine, Dermatology and venereology, Epidemiology, Medical statistics, Community medicine, Law of medicine, Radiology, Psychiatry, Neurology, Anesthesiology, Ophthalmology, Otolaryngology (E.N.T.), Stomatology, Internal medicine, Surgery, Obstetrics and Gynecology, Lemology, Rehabilitation medicine, Pediatrics, Organic chemistry, Public health management, Hygienics, Traditional Chinese medicine, Emergency medicine. (The curriculums may be adjusted according to the university arrangement at that time) Internship Information: The following teaching hospitals are the allotted places for the international students to do their internship: 1. The First Affiliated Hospital of NMU 2. The Second Affiliated Hospital of NMU 3. Nanjing First Hospital 4. Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital Students can choose to do the internship/training in China or in their home country. But, students should come back to take the final examination on Theory Test (internal medicine, surgery, surgery, and pediatrics) and Clinical Evaluation. Note:Students are required to pass HSK 3before graduation; otherwise they cannot get the degree.

duration.text: The Clinical Medicine at Nanjing Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4722 USD/per year ￥ 34000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school. 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) 6.Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: Finished high school studies, aged under 30 and healthy. If failed in HSK, students can attend Chinese language classes after enrollment, and begin medical studies after passing the examination. Materials Needed: 1. A photocopy of the applicant's passport; 2. Passport-size photo; 3. An official certificate of high school graduation certificate; 4. A photocopy of the transcript; 5. A photocopy of HSK certificate; 6. A photocopy of Physical Examination Form for Foreigners
